title: An audit changes expected cash
hook: Two stated cases: explore the detection probability in an explicit payoff model.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the detection probability in an explicit payoff model affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Net, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the detection probability in an explicit payoff model in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
